WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS day_num,
        DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
    WHERE pct.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
      AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) >= '2017-01-01'
      AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY sale_date
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(total_sales, day_num) AS slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(total_sales, day_num) AS intercept
    FROM daily_sales
),
pred_offsets AS (
    SELECT UNNEST([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]) AS offset
),
pred_with_daynum AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE('2018-12-03') + po.offset AS pred_date,
        (DATE('2018-12-03') + po.offset - '2017-01-01'::DATE) + 1 AS day_num
    FROM pred_offsets po
),
predicted AS (
    SELECT 
        p.pred_date,
        p.day_num,
        r.slope * p.day_num + r.intercept AS predicted_sales
    FROM pred_with_daynum p
    CROSS JOIN regression r
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        p.pred_date,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) AS moving_avg_5day
    FROM predicted p
    JOIN predicted p2 
        ON p2.pred_date BETWEEN p.pred_date - INTERVAL '2' DAY AND p.pred_date + INTERVAL '2' DAY
    WHERE p.pred_date IN ('2018-12-05', '2018-12-06', '2018-12-07', '2018-12-08')
    GROUP BY p.pred_date
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg_5day) AS sum_of_moving_averages
FROM moving_averages

WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp,
    o.order_delivered_customer_date
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    do2.order_id,
    do2.customer_unique_id,
    do2.order_purchase_timestamp,
    COALESCE(SUM(op.payment_value), 0) AS order_payment_value
  FROM delivered_orders do2
  LEFT JOIN order_payments op ON do2.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY do2.order_id, do2.customer_unique_id, do2.order_purchase_timestamp
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(order_id) AS num_orders,
    MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase_date,
    SUM(order_payment_value) AS total_spend
  FROM order_totals
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
rfm_raw AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_unique_id,
    num_orders,
    last_purchase_date,
    total_spend,
    CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(last_purchase_date AS TIMESTAMP), CAST('2018-12-31 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DOUBLE) AS recency_days
  FROM customer_metrics
),
rfm_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_unique_id,
    num_orders,
    last_purchase_date,
    total_spend,
    recency_days,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days ASC) AS r_score,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY num_orders DESC) AS f_score,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS m_score
  FROM rfm_raw
),
rfm_segmented AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_unique_id,
    num_orders,
    total_spend,
    recency_days,
    r_score,
    f_score,
    m_score,
    CASE
      WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
      WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
      WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
      WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
      WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
      WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
      WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
      WHEN (r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6) 
        OR (r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
      WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
      WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
      WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS rfm_segment
  FROM rfm_scores
)
SELECT 
  rfm_segment,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(total_spend) / SUM(num_orders), 4) AS avg_sales_per_order,
  ROUND(AVG(total_spend), 2) AS avg_total_spend,
  ROUND(AVG(num_orders), 2) AS avg_num_orders,
  ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 2) AS avg_recency_days
FROM rfm_segmented
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC

WITH order_payments_agg AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) as order_total_payment
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as num_orders,
        AVG(opa.order_total_payment) as avg_payment_per_order,
        date_diff('day', MIN(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)), MAX(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))) as lifespan_days
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments_agg opa ON o.order_id = opa.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    cs.customer_id,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    num_orders,
    avg_payment_per_order,
    CASE WHEN lifespan_days / 7.0 < 1.0 THEN 1.0 ELSE lifespan_days / 7.0 END as lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_stats cs
JOIN customers c ON cs.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Some players have career spans of 0 (debut and final_game are the same day)
-- That's fine - they contribute 0 to the average.

-- The question says "round the result to a float number" - I'll round to 2 decimal places
-- as that's standard for this type of output and matches the intermediate rounding precision.

SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(
        ROUND(ABS(date_diff('year', TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE), TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE))), 2) 
        + ROUND(ABS(date_diff('month', TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE), TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE))) / 12.0, 2) 
        + ROUND(ABS(date_diff('day', TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE), TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE))) / 365.0, 2)
    ), 2) as avg_career_span
FROM player 
WHERE TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE) IS NOT NULL 
  AND TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE) IS NOT NULL
  AND debut != ''
  AND final_game != ''

WITH max_games AS (
  SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER)) as max_g FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
max_runs AS (
  SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER)) as max_r FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
max_hits AS (
  SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER)) as max_h FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
max_hr AS (
  SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER)) as max_hr FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
game_leaders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_id, TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER) as score FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER) = (SELECT max_g FROM max_games)
),
run_leaders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_id, TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER) as score FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER) = (SELECT max_r FROM max_runs)
),
hit_leaders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_id, TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER) as score FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER) = (SELECT max_h FROM max_hits)
),
hr_leaders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_id, TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER) as score FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER) = (SELECT max_hr FROM max_hr)
)
SELECT 'games' as category, p.name_given, gl.score as value FROM game_leaders gl JOIN player p ON gl.player_id = p.player_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'runs', p.name_given, rl.score FROM run_leaders rl JOIN player p ON rl.player_id = p.player_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'hits', p.name_given, hl.score FROM hit_leaders hl JOIN player p ON hl.player_id = p.player_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'home_runs', p.name_given, hrl.score FROM hr_leaders hrl JOIN player p ON hrl.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY category, value DESC

WITH route_distances AS (
    SELECT 
        f.departure_airport,
        f.arrival_airport,
        6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
            POWER(SIN((TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR), POSITION(',' IN CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) + 1, LENGTH(CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - POSITION(',' IN CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 1) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180 - TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(ad1.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, POSITION(',' IN CAST(ad1.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180) / 2), 2)
            + COS(TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(ad1.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, POSITION(',' IN CAST(ad1.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180)
            * COS(TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR), POSITION(',' IN CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) + 1, LENGTH(CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - POSITION(',' IN CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 1) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180)
            * POWER(SIN((TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR), POSITION(',' IN CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) + 1, LENGTH(CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - POSITION(',' IN CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 1) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180 - TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(ad1.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, POSITION(',' IN CAST(ad1.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180) / 2), 2)
        )) AS distance_km
    FROM flights f
    JOIN airports_data ad1 ON ad1.airport_code = f.departure_airport
    JOIN airports_data ad2 ON ad2.airport_code = f.arrival_airport
    WHERE f.departure_airport = 'ABA' OR f.arrival_airport = 'ABA'
)
SELECT MAX(distance_km) AS max_distance_km
FROM route_distances

-- Find the distance range with the fewest unique city pairs, return just the count
WITH flight_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    f.flight_id,
    SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(CAST(dep.city AS VARCHAR), '"en": "', 2), '"', 1) as from_city,
    SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(CAST(arr.city AS VARCHAR), '"en": "', 2), '"', 1) as to_city,
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POW(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 360), 2) + 
      COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) * 
      POW(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 360), 2)
    )) as distance_km
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
      TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lon,
      TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lat,
      TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lon,
      TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lat
  )
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    LEAST(from_city, to_city) as city1,
    GREATEST(from_city, to_city) as city2,
    AVG(distance_km) as avg_distance
  FROM flight_distances
  GROUP BY from_city, to_city
),
with_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    avg_distance,
    CASE 
      WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0'
      WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000'
      ELSE '6000+'
    END as distance_range
  FROM city_pairs
),
range_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    distance_range,
    COUNT(*) as pair_count
  FROM with_ranges
  GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT MIN(pair_count) as fewest_pairs_count
FROM range_counts

-- First, get the helmet group for each case_id, then aggregate
WITH mc_cases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.case_id,
    c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
    CASE 
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM parties p2 
        WHERE CAST(c.case_id AS DOUBLE) = p2.case_id 
          AND p2.statewide_vehicle_type = 'motorcycle or scooter'
          AND (p2.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet used%' OR p2.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet used%')
      ) THEN 'wearing helmets'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM parties p2 
        WHERE CAST(c.case_id AS DOUBLE) = p2.case_id 
          AND p2.statewide_vehicle_type = 'motorcycle or scooter'
          AND (p2.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet not used%' OR p2.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet not used%')
      ) THEN 'not wearing helmets'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END as helmet_group
  FROM collisions c
  WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM parties p 
      WHERE CAST(c.case_id AS DOUBLE) = p.case_id 
        AND p.statewide_vehicle_type = 'motorcycle or scooter'
    )
)
SELECT 
  helmet_group,
  COUNT(*) as total_collisions,
  SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) as motorcyclist_fatalities,
  1.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) / COUNT(*) * 100 as fatality_rate_pct
FROM mc_cases
WHERE helmet_group IN ('wearing helmets', 'not wearing helmets')
GROUP BY helmet_group

WITH yearly_pcf AS (
  SELECT SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) as db_year, primary_collision_factor, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM collisions 
  WHERE primary_collision_factor IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY db_year, primary_collision_factor
), ranked AS (
  SELECT db_year, primary_collision_factor, cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY db_year ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM yearly_pcf
), top2 AS (
  SELECT db_year, 
    LIST(primary_collision_factor ORDER BY cnt DESC) as top2_causes
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY db_year
), most_common_causes AS (
  SELECT primary_collision_factor, COUNT(*) as year_count
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY primary_collision_factor
  ORDER BY year_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
), common_causes AS (
  SELECT primary_collision_factor FROM most_common_causes
)
SELECT t.db_year
FROM top2 t
WHERE t.top2_causes NOT IN (SELECT LIST(primary_collision_factor) FROM common_causes)
LIMIT 1

-- Final result with all required columns
WITH yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS year, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM collisions
  WHERE SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) IN ('2021', '2011')
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4)
),
category_counts AS (
  SELECT SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS year, pcf_violation_category, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM collisions
  WHERE SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) IN ('2021', '2011')
    AND pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL
    AND pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4), pcf_violation_category
),
speeding_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.year,
    cc.pcf_violation_category,
    cc.cnt,
    cc.cnt * 100.0 / yt.total AS share_pct
  FROM category_counts cc
  JOIN yearly_totals yt ON cc.year = yt.year
  WHERE cc.pcf_violation_category = 'speeding'
)
SELECT 
  'speeding' AS pcf_violation_category,
  (SELECT share_pct FROM speeding_shares WHERE year = '2021') AS share_2021_pct,
  (SELECT share_pct FROM speeding_shares WHERE year = '2011') AS share_2011_pct,
  (SELECT share_pct FROM speeding_shares WHERE year = '2011') - 
  (SELECT share_pct FROM speeding_shares WHERE year = '2021') AS decrease_pp

SELECT m.duration, w1.name as winner_name, w2.name as loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id
WHERE m.title_id = 23153 
  AND m.title_change = 0 
  AND m.duration != ''
  AND m.duration = (
    SELECT MIN(m2.duration)
    FROM Matches m2
    WHERE m2.title_id = 23153 
      AND m2.title_change = 0 
      AND m2.duration != ''
  )
GROUP BY m.duration, w1.name, w2.name

-- Compute runs conceded and wickets per bowler, return only the bowler with the lowest average
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bats.runs_scored) AS runs_off_bat
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bats ON b.match_id = bats.match_id AND b.over_id = bats.over_id AND b.ball_id = bats.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bats.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_extras AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(e.extra_runs) AS extras_charged
    FROM extra_runs e
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON e.match_id = b.match_id AND e.over_id = b.over_id AND e.ball_id = b.ball_id AND e.innings_no = b.innings_no
    WHERE e.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs', 'penalty')
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) AS wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COALESCE(br.runs_off_bat, 0) + COALESCE(be.extras_charged, 0) AS total_runs_conceded,
    bw.wickets,
    1.0 * (COALESCE(br.runs_off_bat, 0) + COALESCE(be.extras_charged, 0)) / bw.wickets AS bowling_average
FROM bowler_wickets bw
JOIN bowler_runs br ON bw.bowler = br.bowler
LEFT JOIN bowler_extras be ON bw.bowler = be.bowler
JOIN player p ON bw.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

-- Double check: verify the number of qualifying strikers and the average
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
  SELECT bb.striker, bb.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
  FROM batsman_scored bs
  JOIN ball_by_ball bb 
    ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id 
    AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id 
    AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
    AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
  GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
  HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) > 50
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT striker FROM striker_match_runs
),
striker_total_runs AS (
  SELECT bb.striker, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
  FROM batsman_scored bs
  JOIN ball_by_ball bb 
    ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id 
    AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id 
    AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
    AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
  WHERE bb.striker IN (SELECT striker FROM qualifying_strikers)
  GROUP BY bb.striker
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as num_strikers, AVG(total_runs) as average_total_runs, MIN(total_runs) as min_runs, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
FROM striker_total_runs

-- Get distinct player names who scored >= 100 runs in a match while playing for the losing team
WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker AS player_id, bbb.match_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
    HAVING SUM(bbs.runs_scored) >= 100
),
player_team_info AS (
    SELECT pmr.player_id, pmr.match_id, pmr.total_runs, pm.team_id
    FROM player_match_runs pmr
    JOIN player_match pm ON pmr.match_id = pm.match_id AND pmr.player_id = pm.player_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM player_team_info pti
JOIN match m ON pti.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pti.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pti.team_id != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name

-- Top 5 players by batting average (runs/dismissals) in season 5
-- Only include players who have been dismissed at least once
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.striker, p.player_name, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    JOIN player p ON bb.striker = p.player_id
    JOIN match m ON bs.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY bb.striker, p.player_name
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT w.player_out, p.player_name, COUNT(*) as dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN match m ON w.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN player p ON w.player_out = p.player_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY w.player_out, p.player_name
)
SELECT pr.player_name, 1.0 * pr.total_runs / pd.dismissals as batting_average
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN player_dismissals pd ON pr.striker = pd.player_out
WHERE pd.dismissals > 0
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5

-- Final query: Top 5 countries by average of player average runs per match
WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker AS player_id,
        b.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(total_runs) AS career_runs,
        COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
        SUM(total_runs) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_match_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT 
    p.country_name,
    AVG(pa.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_avg
FROM player_avg pa
JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.country_name

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(b.match_id, e.match_id) AS match_id,
        COALESCE(b.over_id, e.over_id) AS over_id,
        COALESCE(b.innings_no, e.innings_no) AS innings_no,
        COALESCE(SUM(b.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(e.extra_runs), 0) AS total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored b
    FULL OUTER JOIN extra_runs e 
        ON b.match_id = e.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = e.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    GROUP BY COALESCE(b.match_id, e.match_id), COALESCE(b.over_id, e.over_id), COALESCE(b.innings_no, e.innings_no)
),
ranked_over AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, over_id, innings_no, total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, over_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM over_runs
),
top_over AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, total_runs
    FROM ranked_over
    WHERE rn = 1
)

WITH ordered AS (

        LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) as prev_lng,
        LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) as prev_city,
        LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) as prev_state,
        LAG(geolocation_zip_code_prefix) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) as prev_zip,
        LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) as prev_lng_val
    FROM ordered

            SIN(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(geolocation_lat))

WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_total
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
        AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT ch.channel_id FROM channels ch WHERE ch.channel_total_id = 1)
        AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT p.promo_id FROM promotions p WHERE p.promo_total_id = 1)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_total ELSE 0 END) as sales_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_total ELSE 0 END) as sales_2020
    FROM france_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_number
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_total ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_total ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
projected AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        sales_2019,
        sales_2020,
        (((sales_2020 - sales_2019) / sales_2019) * sales_2020) + sales_2020 as projected_2021
    FROM pivoted
),
with_currency AS (
    SELECT 
        p.prod_id,
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.projected_2021 * c.to_us as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected p
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' 
        AND c.year = 2021 
        AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        ROUND(AVG(projected_2021_usd), 2) as avg_monthly_usd
    FROM with_currency
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        avg_monthly_usd,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_monthly_usd) as rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER () as cnt
    FROM monthly_averages
)
SELECT AVG(1.0 * avg_monthly_usd) as median_of_avg_monthly_projected_sales_usd
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN (cnt / 2 + 1, cnt / 2 + (cnt % 2));

  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND cu.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    pqs.prod_name,
    pqs.calendar_year,
    pqs.product_sales,
    tsql.total_sales,
    1.0 * pqs.product_sales / tsql.total_sales as share
  FROM product_quarter_sales pqs
  JOIN total_sales_by_quarter tsql ON pqs.calendar_year = tsql.calendar_year
),
pivot_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    prod_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share ELSE NULL END) as share_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share ELSE NULL END) as share_2020
  FROM product_shares
  GROUP BY prod_name
)
SELECT 
  prod_name,
  share_2019,
  share_2020,
  share_2020 - share_2019 as share_change
FROM pivot_shares
ORDER BY share_change DESC

-- Final result
WITH france_sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_month_desc, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_amount
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France' AND t.calendar_year = 2019
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_month_desc
),
france_sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_month_desc, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_amount
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France' AND t.calendar_year = 2020
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_month_desc
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        f1.prod_id,
        f1.calendar_month_number,
        f1.calendar_month_desc,
        f1.total_amount as sales_2019,
        f2.total_amount as sales_2020
    FROM france_sales_2019 f1
    JOIN france_sales_2020 f2 ON f1.prod_id = f2.prod_id AND f1.calendar_month_number = f2.calendar_month_number
),
projected AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        calendar_month_desc,
        sales_2020 + ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) / sales_2019) * sales_2020 as projected_2021_local
    FROM combined
),
with_usd AS (
    SELECT 
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.calendar_month_desc,
        p.projected_2021_local * c.to_us as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected p
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' AND c.year = 2021 AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT 
    '2021-' || LPAD(CAST(calendar_month_number AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') as calendar_month,
    ROUND(AVG(projected_2021_usd), 2) as avg_projected_monthly_sales_usd
FROM with_usd
GROUP BY calendar_month_number, calendar_month_desc
ORDER BY calendar_month_number

-- Final query with bucket range labels
WITH customer_profits AS (
    SELECT c.cust_id, 
           SUM(p.quantity_sold * (p.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) as total_profit
    FROM customers c
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN profits p ON c.cust_id = p.cust_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND p.time_id >= DATE '2021-12-01'
    AND p.time_id <= DATE '2021-12-31'
    GROUP BY c.cust_id
),
range_stats AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_profit) as min_profit, MAX(total_profit) as max_profit
    FROM customer_profits
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT cp.cust_id, cp.total_profit,
           LEAST(CAST((cp.total_profit - rs.min_profit) / ((rs.max_profit - rs.min_profit) / 10.0) AS INTEGER), 9) as bucket_num
    FROM customer_profits cp
    CROSS JOIN range_stats rs
)
SELECT 
    bucket_num + 1 as bucket,
    COUNT(*) as num_customers,
    MIN(total_profit) as min_profit,
    MAX(total_profit) as max_profit
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket_num
ORDER BY bucket_num

WITH qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'

    GROUP BY c.cust_city
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) >= 1.2
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           t.calendar_quarter_id,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)

    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
quarter_totals AS (

),
product_shares AS (

    FROM product_quarter_sales pq
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON pq.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_total_sales AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
    FROM product_total_sales
),
top_20_percent AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE rn <= CAST(CEIL(0.2 * total_count) AS INTEGER)
),
q4_2019_shares AS (
    SELECT prod_id, share_pct as share_q4_2019
    FROM product_shares
    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1772
),
q4_2020_shares AS (
    SELECT prod_id, share_pct as share_q4_2020
    FROM product_shares
    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1776
),
product_changes AS (
    SELECT t20.prod_id,
           q420.share_q4_2020,
           q419.share_q4_2019,
           q420.share_q4_2020 - q419.share_q4_2019 as pct_point_change
    FROM top_20_percent t20
    JOIN q4_2019_shares q419 ON t20.prod_id = q419.prod_id
    JOIN q4_2020_shares q420 ON t20.prod_id = q420.prod_id
)
SELECT prod_id, pct_point_change
FROM product_changes
ORDER BY ABS(pct_point_change) ASC
LIMIT 1

-- Calculate month-end balance per customer per month, then find highest and lowest positive count months
WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
        customer_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) - 
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
    GROUP BY substr(txn_date, 1, 7), customer_id
),
monthly_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_count,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance_all_customers
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        positive_count,
        avg_balance_all_customers,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) as rank_highest,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) as rank_lowest
    FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_balance_all_customers FROM ranked_months WHERE rank_highest = 1) as highest_month_avg,
    (SELECT avg_balance_all_customers FROM ranked_months WHERE rank_lowest = 1) as lowest_month_avg,
    (SELECT avg_balance_all_customers FROM ranked_months WHERE rank_highest = 1) - 
    (SELECT avg_balance_all_customers FROM ranked_months WHERE rank_lowest = 1) as difference

-- OK so in the original table, order 10 has 2 rows for pizza_id 1 with different extras/exclusions
-- In the clean table, order 10 also has 2 rows for pizza_id 1 with different extras/exclusions
-- So these are legitimate separate pizza items within the same order

-- For order 4, the original has 3 rows: 2 identical for pizza_id 1, and 1 for pizza_id 2
-- The clean table mirrors this

-- So the clean table is faithful to the original. Let me just sum up all the item prices
-- for non-canceled orders with pizza_id 1 or 2

WITH valid_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.pizza_id,
        co.extras,
        CASE 
            WHEN co.pizza_id = 1 THEN 12.0
            WHEN co.pizza_id = 2 THEN 10.0
            ELSE 0
        END as base_price,
        CASE 
            WHEN co.extras IS NULL OR co.extras = '' THEN 0
            ELSE (LENGTH(co.extras) - LENGTH(REPLACE(co.extras, ',', '')) + 1)
        END as extras_count
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
    WHERE (ro.cancellation IS NULL OR ro.cancellation = '')
    AND co.pizza_id IN (1, 2)
)
SELECT SUM(base_price + extras_count * 1.0) as total_income
FROM valid_orders;

-- Build all ingredient occurrences for delivered orders
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id 
    FROM pizza_clean_runner_orders 
    WHERE cancellation IS NULL
),
order_pizzas AS (
    SELECT co.order_id, co.pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    WHERE co.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
),
pizza_standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT op.order_id,
           CAST(TRIM(UNNEST(SPLIT(TRIM(pr.toppings), ','))) AS BIGINT) AS topping_id
    FROM order_pizzas op
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON op.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
order_extras AS (
    SELECT pe.order_id, CAST(pe.extras AS BIGINT) AS topping_id, pe.extras_count
    FROM pizza_get_extras pe
    WHERE pe.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
),
order_exclusions AS (
    SELECT pg.order_id, CAST(pg.exclusions AS BIGINT) AS excluded_topping_id, pg.total_exclusions
    FROM pizza_get_exclusions pg
    WHERE pg.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
),
all_ingredients AS (
    -- Standard toppings (each pizza item contributes its toppings)
    SELECT topping_id, 1 AS qty
    FROM pizza_standard_toppings
    UNION ALL
    -- Extra toppings (extras_count tells how many times)
    SELECT topping_id, extras_count AS qty
    FROM order_extras
    UNION ALL
    -- Exclusions (negative, total_exclusions tells how many times)
    SELECT excluded_topping_id, -total_exclusions AS qty
    FROM order_exclusions
)
SELECT pt.topping_name, CAST(SUM(ai.qty) AS INTEGER) AS total_qty
FROM all_ingredients ai
JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON ai.topping_id = pt.topping_id
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
HAVING SUM(ai.qty) > 0
ORDER BY pt.topping_name

WITH customer_profits AS (

tiered AS (

         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) as tier

WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM insert_date::DATE) AS year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM insert_date::DATE) AS month_num,
        CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM insert_date::DATE)
            WHEN 4 THEN 'April'
            WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
            WHEN 6 THEN 'June'
        END AS month_name,
        COUNT(*) AS city_count
    FROM cities
    WHERE insert_date::DATE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM insert_date::DATE) IN (4, 5, 6)
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM insert_date::DATE), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM insert_date::DATE)
),
with_running_total AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month_num,
        month_name,
        city_count,
        SUM(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
    FROM monthly_counts
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month_num,
        month_name,
        city_count,
        running_total,
        LAG(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year) AS prev_city_count,
        LAG(running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year) AS prev_running_total
    FROM with_running_total
)
SELECT 
    year,
    month_name,
    city_count,
    CAST(running_total AS INTEGER) AS running_total,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_city_count IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * (city_count - prev_city_count) / prev_city_count
        ELSE NULL
    END AS monthly_growth_pct,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_running_total IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * (running_total - prev_running_total) / prev_running_total
        ELSE NULL
    END AS running_total_growth_pct
FROM with_lag
WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY month_num, year

WITH dates_with_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(insert_date AS DATE) as insert_date 
    FROM cities 
    WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn' 
      AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01' 
      AND insert_date <= '2021-07-31'
),
numbered AS (
    SELECT insert_date, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY insert_date) as rn
    FROM dates_with_entries
),
groups AS (
    SELECT insert_date,
           insert_date - (rn || ' day')::INTERVAL as grp
    FROM numbered
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT grp, COUNT(*) as streak_length, MIN(insert_date) as start_date, MAX(insert_date) as end_date
    FROM groups
    GROUP BY grp
),
streak_info AS (
    SELECT streak_length, start_date, end_date
    FROM streaks
    WHERE streak_length IN (
        (SELECT MIN(streak_length) FROM streaks),
        (SELECT MAX(streak_length) FROM streaks)
    )
),
city_per_date AS (
    SELECT c.insert_date, c.city_id, c.city_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) ORDER BY c.city_id) as rn
    FROM cities c
    WHERE c.country_code_2 = 'cn' 
      AND CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) >= '2021-07-01' 
      AND CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) <= '2021-07-31'
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    sd.insert_date,
    UPPER(SUBSTRING(FIRST_VALUE(cp.city_name) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.insert_date ORDER BY cp.city_id), 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTRING(FIRST_VALUE(cp.city_name) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.insert_date ORDER BY cp.city_id), 2)) as city_name
FROM streak_info si
JOIN dates_with_entries sd ON sd.insert_date >= si.start_date AND sd.insert_date <= si.end_date
JOIN city_per_date cp ON CAST(cp.insert_date AS DATE) = sd.insert_date
ORDER BY sd.insert_date

-- For each country, find its maximum streak length, then find the global maximum
WITH june_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2, CAST(insert_date AS DATE) AS d
    FROM cities 
    WHERE insert_date >= '2022-06-01' AND insert_date <= '2022-06-30'
),
numbered AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, d,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY d) AS rn
    FROM june_dates
),
groups AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, d, rn,
           d - INTERVAL (rn) DAY AS grp
    FROM numbered
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_length
    FROM groups
    GROUP BY country_code_2, grp
),
max_streaks AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, MAX(streak_length) AS max_streak
    FROM streaks
    GROUP BY country_code_2
)
SELECT country_code_2, max_streak
FROM max_streaks
ORDER BY max_streak DESC, country_code_2
LIMIT 20

WITH ir_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(insert_date AS DATE) as d
    FROM cities
    WHERE country_code_2 = 'ir' 
      AND insert_date >= '2022-01-01' 
      AND insert_date <= '2022-01-31'
),
numbered AS (
    SELECT d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d) as rn
    FROM ir_dates
),
groups AS (
    SELECT d, rn, d - INTERVAL (rn) DAY as grp
    FROM numbered
),
consecutive AS (
    SELECT grp, MIN(d) as start_date, MAX(d) as end_date, COUNT(*) as length
    FROM groups
    GROUP BY grp
),
longest AS (
    SELECT start_date, end_date
    FROM consecutive
    ORDER BY length DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
period_entries AS (
    SELECT 
        c.capital,
        (SELECT start_date FROM longest) as period_start,
        (SELECT end_date FROM longest) as period_end
    FROM cities c
    WHERE c.country_code_2 = 'ir'
      AND CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT start_date FROM longest)
      AND CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT end_date FROM longest)
)
SELECT 
    'iran' as country_name,
    (SELECT start_date FROM longest) as period_start,
    (SELECT end_date FROM longest) as period_end,
    CAST(SUM(capital) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) as proportion_capital
FROM period_entries

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, pizza_id) as row_id,
    order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time
  FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
standard AS (
  SELECT 
    b.row_id, b.order_id, b.customer_id, b.pizza_id, b.order_time,
    CAST(TRIM(t2.value) AS INTEGER) as topping_id,
    t.topping_name
  FROM base b
  JOIN pizza_recipes r ON r.pizza_id = b.pizza_id
  JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(regexp_split_to_array(r.toppings, ',\s*')) AS t2(value) ON true
  JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = CAST(TRIM(t2.value) AS INTEGER)
),
excluded AS (
  SELECT 
    b.row_id,
    CAST(TRIM(t2.value) AS INTEGER) as excluded_topping_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(regexp_split_to_array(NULLIF(b.exclusions, ''), ',')) AS t2(value) ON true
  WHERE b.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND b.exclusions != ''
),
extra AS (
  SELECT 
    b.row_id,
    CAST(TRIM(t2.value) AS INTEGER) as extra_topping_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(regexp_split_to_array(NULLIF(b.extras, ''), ',')) AS t2(value) ON true
  WHERE b.extras IS NOT NULL AND b.extras != ''
),
all_toppings AS (
  SELECT s.row_id, s.order_id, s.customer_id, s.pizza_id, s.order_time, s.topping_name
  FROM standard s
  LEFT JOIN excluded e ON e.row_id = s.row_id AND e.excluded_topping_id = s.topping_id
  WHERE e.excluded_topping_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.row_id, b.order_id, b.customer_id, b.pizza_id, b.order_time, t.topping_name
  FROM extra e
  JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = e.extra_topping_id
  JOIN base b ON b.row_id = e.row_id
),
counted AS (
  SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_name, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM all_toppings
  GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_name
),
named AS (
  SELECT 
    row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time,
    topping_name,
    cnt,
    CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END as formatted_ingredient,
    CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as sort_key
  FROM counted
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time,
    string_agg(formatted_ingredient, ', ' ORDER BY sort_key ASC, formatted_ingredient ASC) as ingredients
  FROM named
  GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time
),
with_pizza_info AS (
  SELECT 
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_id,
    CASE WHEN pizza_id = 1 THEN 'Meatlovers' ELSE 'Vegetarian' END as pizza_name,
    ingredients
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  row_id,
  order_id,
  customer_id,
  pizza_name,
  pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients as ingredients
FROM with_pizza_info
ORDER BY row_id

WITH RECURSIVE monthly_months AS (
    SELECT DATE '2020-01-01' as month_start, DATE '2020-01-31' as month_end
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month_start + INTERVAL '1' MONTH, month_start + INTERVAL '2' MONTH - INTERVAL '1' DAY
    FROM monthly_months
    WHERE month_start < DATE '2020-04-01'
),
customer_months AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month_start, m.month_end
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions) c
    CROSS JOIN monthly_months m
),
daily_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_day,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                    WHEN txn_type IN ('purchase', 'withdrawal') THEN -txn_amount
                    ELSE 0 END)::BIGINT as daily_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
),
cumulative_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           txn_day,
           SUM(daily_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_day)::BIGINT as running_balance
    FROM daily_net
),
monthly_closing AS (
    SELECT cm.customer_id,
           cm.month_start,
           cm.month_end,
           COALESCE(cb.running_balance, 0)::BIGINT as closing_balance
    FROM customer_months cm
    LEFT JOIN cumulative_balance cb 
        ON cm.customer_id = cb.customer_id 
        AND cb.txn_day <= cm.month_end
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cm.customer_id, cm.month_start ORDER BY cb.txn_day DESC) = 1
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        month_end,
        closing_balance,
        LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) as prev_balance,
        SUM(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::BIGINT as cumulative_balance
    FROM monthly_closing
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    CAST(month_start AS VARCHAR) as month_start,
    CAST(month_end AS VARCHAR) as month_end,
    closing_balance,
    CASE WHEN prev_balance IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE closing_balance - prev_balance
    END as monthly_change,
    cumulative_balance
FROM with_lag
ORDER BY customer_id, month_start

WITH visit_purchases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE page_id = 13 AND event_type = 3
),
visit_product_views AS (
    SELECT 
        e.visit_id,
        p.product_id,
        COUNT(*) as page_view_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) AND e.event_type = 1
    GROUP BY e.visit_id, p.product_id
),
visit_product_adds AS (
    SELECT 
        e.visit_id,
        p.product_id,
        COUNT(*) as add_to_cart_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) AND e.event_type = 2
    GROUP BY e.visit_id, p.product_id
),
visit_product_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        vpv.visit_id,
        vpv.product_id,
        vpv.page_view_count,
        COALESCE(vpa.add_to_cart_count, 0) as add_to_cart_count,
        CASE WHEN vp.visit_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as was_purchased
    FROM visit_product_views vpv
    LEFT JOIN visit_product_adds vpa ON vpv.visit_id = vpa.visit_id AND vpv.product_id = vpa.product_id
    LEFT JOIN visit_purchases vp ON vpv.visit_id = vp.visit_id
)
SELECT 
    CAST(product_id AS INTEGER) as product_id,
    CAST(SUM(page_view_count) AS INTEGER) as times_viewed,
    CAST(SUM(add_to_cart_count) AS INTEGER) as times_added_to_cart,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN was_purchased = 0 THEN add_to_cart_count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as times_left_in_cart,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN was_purchased = 1 THEN add_to_cart_count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as times_purchased
FROM visit_product_stats
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

WITH monthly_avg AS (

    FROM interest_metrics

    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
top_interest AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_with_name AS (
    SELECT 
        ti.month_year,
        im.interest_name,
        ti.avg_composition as max_index_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ti.month_year ORDER BY ti.avg_composition DESC) as rn
    FROM top_interest ti
    JOIN interest_map im ON ti.interest_id = im.id
    WHERE ti.rn = 1
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_name,
        max_index_composition,
        AVG(max_index_composition) OVER (ORDER BY month_year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_avg,
        LAG(interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_year) as prev1_interest_name,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_year) as prev1_max_index_composition,
        LAG(interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_year) as prev2_interest_name,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_year) as prev2_max_index_composition
    FROM top_with_name
)
SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_name,
    max_index_composition,
    rolling_avg,
    prev1_interest_name,
    prev1_max_index_composition,
    prev2_interest_name,
    prev2_max_index_composition
FROM ordered
ORDER BY month_year

-- Build the query: for each interest, find the month with highest composition
-- Then rank them and take top 10 and bottom 10
WITH interest_max AS (
    SELECT CAST(interest_id AS INTEGER) as interest_id, 
           month_year,
           composition
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE month_year IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(interest_id AS INTEGER) ORDER BY composition DESC, month_year ASC) = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT im.interest_id, 
           im.month_year as time,
           im.composition,
           im_name.interest_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY im.composition DESC) as rank_desc,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY im.composition ASC) as rank_asc
    FROM interest_max im
    JOIN interest_map im_name ON CAST(im.interest_id AS BIGINT) = im_name.id
),
top_bottom AS (
    SELECT 'top' as category, interest_id, time, interest_name, composition, rank_desc
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rank_desc <= 10
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'bottom' as category, interest_id, time, interest_name, composition, rank_desc
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rank_asc <= 10
)
SELECT category, interest_id, time, interest_name, composition
FROM top_bottom
ORDER BY composition DESC

WITH region_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,

    FROM web_region r
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.region_id = r.id
    JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
    GROUP BY r.name
),
rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,
        sr.name AS sales_rep_name,
        sr.id AS sales_rep_id,
        COUNT(o.id) AS rep_orders,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total_sales
    FROM web_region r
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.region_id = r.id
    JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
    GROUP BY r.name, sr.name, sr.id
),
ranked_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        sales_rep_name,
        sales_rep_id,
        rep_orders,
        rep_total_sales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY rep_total_sales DESC) AS rnk
    FROM rep_sales
)

    rs.region_name,
    rs.total_orders,
    rs.region_total_sales,
    rr.sales_rep_name,

FROM region_summary rs
JOIN ranked_reps rr ON rr.region_name = rs.region_name AND rr.rnk = 1
ORDER BY rs.region_name, rr.sales_rep_name

WITH english_completers AS (
    SELECT s.StudentID, s.StudLastName, ss.Grade
    FROM Students s
    JOIN Student_Schedules ss ON s.StudentID = ss.StudentID
    JOIN Classes cl ON ss.ClassID = cl.ClassID
    JOIN Subjects sub ON cl.SubjectID = sub.SubjectID
    WHERE sub.SubjectCode LIKE 'ENG%' AND ss.ClassStatus = 2
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT ec.StudentID, ec.StudLastName, ec.Grade,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_completers ec2 WHERE ec2.Grade >= ec.Grade) AS rank_num,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_completers) AS total
    FROM english_completers ec
),
with_quintile AS (
    SELECT StudLastName, Grade,
           CASE 
               WHEN 1.0 * rank_num / total <= 0.20 THEN 'First'
               WHEN 1.0 * rank_num / total <= 0.40 THEN 'Second'
               WHEN 1.0 * rank_num / total <= 0.60 THEN 'Third'
               WHEN 1.0 * rank_num / total <= 0.80 THEN 'Fourth'
               ELSE 'Fifth'
           END AS quintile_label,
           CASE 
               WHEN 1.0 * rank_num / total <= 0.20 THEN 1
               WHEN 1.0 * rank_num / total <= 0.40 THEN 2
               WHEN 1.0 * rank_num / total <= 0.60 THEN 3
               WHEN 1.0 * rank_num / total <= 0.80 THEN 4
               ELSE 5
           END AS quintile_order
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT StudLastName, quintile_label
FROM with_quintile
ORDER BY quintile_order, Grade DESC

WITH customer_prefs AS (

        MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_pref,
        MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_pref
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
entertainer_strengths AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_strength,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_strength
    FROM (
        SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID, StyleStrength,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC, StyleID) as rn
        FROM Entertainer_Styles
    ) sub
    WHERE rn <= 2
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
FROM customer_prefs cp
JOIN entertainer_strengths es ON 1=1
JOIN Customers c ON cp.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN Entertainers e ON es.EntertainerID = e.EntertainerID
WHERE (cp.first_pref = es.first_strength AND cp.second_pref = es.second_strength)
   OR (cp.first_pref = es.second_strength AND cp.second_pref = es.first_strength)
ORDER BY e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName

-- Final: Calculate absolute difference between each style's weighted score and the average
WITH style_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        mp.StyleID,
        ms.StyleName,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN 3 
                 WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN 2 
                 WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 3 THEN 1 
                 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS total_weighted_score
    FROM Musical_Preferences mp
    JOIN Musical_Styles ms ON mp.StyleID = ms.StyleID
    GROUP BY mp.StyleID, ms.StyleName
),
avg_score AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_weighted_score) AS avg_weighted_score
    FROM style_scores
)
SELECT 
    ss.StyleID,
    ss.StyleName,
    ss.total_weighted_score,
    avg_score.avg_weighted_score,
    ABS(ss.total_weighted_score - avg_score.avg_weighted_score) AS abs_difference
FROM style_scores ss
CROSS JOIN avg_score
ORDER BY ss.StyleID;

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) as businessentityid,
           CASE 
             WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) >= 5 THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE))
             ELSE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) - 1
           END as fiscal_year,
           SUM(TRY_CAST(totaldue AS DOUBLE)) as total_sales
    FROM salesorderheader 
    WHERE TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER),
             CASE 
               WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) >= 5 THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE))
               ELSE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) - 1
             END
),
quota_agg AS (
    SELECT BusinessEntityID,
           CASE 
             WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(QuotaDate, ' ', 1) AS DATE)) >= 5 THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(QuotaDate, ' ', 1) AS DATE))
             ELSE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(QuotaDate, ' ', 1) AS DATE)) - 1
           END as fiscal_year,
           SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) as total_quota
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY BusinessEntityID,
             CASE 
               WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(QuotaDate, ' ', 1) AS DATE)) >= 5 THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(QuotaDate, ' ', 1) AS DATE))
               ELSE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(QuotaDate, ' ', 1) AS DATE)) - 1
             END
)
SELECT q.businessentityid as salesperson_id,
       q.fiscal_year as year,
       COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) as total_sales,
       COALESCE(q.total_quota, 0) as total_quota,
       COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.total_quota, 0) as difference
FROM quota_agg q
LEFT JOIN sales_agg s ON q.BusinessEntityID = s.businessentityid AND q.fiscal_year = s.fiscal_year
ORDER BY q.businessentityid, q.fiscal_year

WITH director_movies AS (

director_with_ranks AS (

),
inter_movie_gaps AS (
  SELECT d1.name_id,

  FROM director_with_ranks d1
  JOIN director_with_ranks d2 ON d1.name_id = d2.name_id AND d1.rn = d2.rn + 1
),
director_avg_gaps AS (

director_counts AS (

director_ratings AS (

SELECT dc.name_id,

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    m.region,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(t.txn_date, '-', 3) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(t.txn_date, '-', 2) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(t.txn_date, '-', 1) AS DATE))::INT as txn_year,
    t.quantity,
    p.price,
    t.quantity * p.price as dollar_amount
  FROM bitcoin_transactions t
  JOIN bitcoin_members m ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  JOIN bitcoin_prices p ON t.ticker = p.ticker 
    AND TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(t.txn_date, '-', 3) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(t.txn_date, '-', 2) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(t.txn_date, '-', 1) AS DATE) = TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.market_date, '-', 3) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(p.market_date, '-', 2) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(p.market_date, '-', 1) AS DATE)
  WHERE t.ticker = 'BTC' AND t.txn_type = 'BUY'
),
annual_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    txn_year,
    SUM(dollar_amount) as total_dollar_amount,
    SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
    SUM(dollar_amount) / SUM(quantity) as avg_purchase_price
  FROM base
  GROUP BY region, txn_year
),
with_first_year AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    txn_year,
    total_dollar_amount,
    total_quantity,
    avg_purchase_price,
    MIN(txn_year) OVER (PARTITION BY region) as first_year
  FROM annual_totals
),
excluded_first_year AS (
  SELECT region, txn_year, total_dollar_amount, total_quantity, avg_purchase_price
  FROM with_first_year
  WHERE txn_year != first_year
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    txn_year,
    total_dollar_amount,
    total_quantity,
    avg_purchase_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_year ORDER BY avg_purchase_price DESC) as rank
  FROM excluded_first_year
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    txn_year,
    total_dollar_amount,
    total_quantity,
    avg_purchase_price,
    rank,
    LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) as prev_avg_price
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT 
  region,
  txn_year,
  total_dollar_amount,
  total_quantity,
  avg_purchase_price,
  rank,
  CASE 
    WHEN prev_avg_price IS NOT NULL AND prev_avg_price != 0 
    THEN (avg_purchase_price - prev_avg_price) / prev_avg_price * 100 
    ELSE NULL 
  END as pct_change
FROM with_prev
ORDER BY txn_year, rank

WITH parsed_data AS (

        volume,
        CASE 
            WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
            WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'M', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000000
            WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000
            ELSE TRY_CAST(volume AS DOUBLE)
        END as volume_numeric
    FROM bitcoin_prices
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(market_date, '-', 3) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(market_date, '-', 2) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(market_date, '-', 1) AS DATE) BETWEEN '2021-08-01' AND '2021-08-10'
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        ticker,
        market_date_parsed,
        volume,
        volume_numeric,
        LAG(volume_numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY market_date_parsed) as prev_volume
    FROM parsed_data
)
SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date_parsed as market_date,
    volume,
    volume_numeric,
    prev_volume,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_volume IS NOT NULL AND prev_volume != 0 
        THEN (volume_numeric - prev_volume) / prev_volume * 100.0
        ELSE NULL
    END as daily_pct_change
FROM with_prev
ORDER BY ticker, market_date_parsed;

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lt.id_bioguide, 
           CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
      AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) >= '1917-01-01'
      AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= '1999-12-31'
),
periods AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, 
           year_num,
           DATE_TRUNC('year', CAST(first_term_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL (year_num) YEAR) 
               + INTERVAL 364 DAY as check_date
    FROM cohort,
         UNNEST(generate_series(1, 20)) AS t(year_num)
),
retained AS (
    SELECT p.id_bioguide, p.year_num,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
               WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = p.id_bioguide
                 AND CAST(lt2.term_start AS DATE) <= p.check_date
                 AND CAST(lt2.term_end AS DATE) >= p.check_date
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_retained
    FROM periods p
)
SELECT year_num, 
       1.0 * SUM(is_retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
FROM retained
GROUP BY year_num
ORDER BY year_num

WITH first_terms AS (

        DATE_TRUNC('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL '2 years' + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as check_2,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL '4 years' + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as check_4,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL '6 years' + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as check_6,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL '8 years' + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as check_8,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL '10 years' + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as check_10
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
retention AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.state,

        ft.first_term_start,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_0
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_0
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ret_0,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_2
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_2
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ret_2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_4
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_4
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ret_4,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_6
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_6
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ret_6,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_8
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_8
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ret_8,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_10
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_10

state_gender_retention AS (
    SELECT

    HAVING SUM(ret_0) > 0 AND SUM(ret_2) > 0 AND SUM(ret_4) > 0

states_with_both AS (

legislator_years AS (
    SELECT 
        m.id_bioguide,

with_lag AS (

    FROM monthly_payments mp
    JOIN top10 t ON mp.customer_id = t.customer_id
)

    payment_month,

WITH feb_mar AS (
    SELECT 
        s.hub_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as feb_orders,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mar_orders
    FROM orders o
    JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
        AND o.order_created_year = 2021
        AND o.order_created_month IN (2, 3)
    GROUP BY s.hub_id
)

    h.hub_id,
    h.hub_name,
    feb_orders,
    mar_orders,
    (1.0 * (mar_orders - feb_orders) / feb_orders) * 100 as pct_increase

WHERE feb_orders > 0
    AND (1.0 * (mar_orders - feb_orders) / feb_orders) > 0.20

  UNION ALL
  SELECT away_player_11, home_team_goal, away_team_goal, 'away' FROM Match WHERE away_player_11 IS NOT NULL
),
result AS (
  SELECT player_api_id,
    CASE WHEN (side = 'home' AND home_team_goal > away_team_goal) OR (side = 'away' AND away_team_goal > home_team_goal) THEN 'win'
         WHEN (side = 'home' AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal) OR (side = 'away' AND away_team_goal < home_team_goal) THEN 'loss'
         ELSE 'draw' END as match_result
  FROM player_matches
  WHERE home_team_goal != away_team_goal
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT player_api_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE match_result = 'win') as win_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE match_result = 'loss') as loss_count
  FROM result
  GROUP BY player_api_id
),
top_win AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, win_count
  FROM player_stats
  ORDER BY win_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
top_loss AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, loss_count
  FROM player_stats
  ORDER BY loss_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  pw.player_name as winning_player,
  tw.win_count as winning_matches,
  pl.player_name as losing_player,
  tl.loss_count as losing_matches
FROM top_win tw
JOIN Player pw ON pw.player_api_id = tw.player_api_id
CROSS JOIN top_loss tl
JOIN Player pl ON pl.player_api_id = tl.player_api_id

WITH home_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        t.team_long_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
    GROUP BY t.team_long_name
),
away_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        t.team_long_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
    GROUP BY t.team_long_name
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(hw.team_long_name, aw.team_long_name) AS team_long_name,
    CAST(COALESCE(hw.wins, 0) + COALESCE(aw.wins, 0) AS INTEGER) AS total_wins
FROM home_wins hw
FULL OUTER JOIN away_wins aw ON hw.team_long_name = aw.team_long_name
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH batsmen_runs AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, bbb.striker AS player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored)::BIGINT AS total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY SUM(bs.runs_scored) DESC, bbb.striker ASC) AS rn
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
      AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON bbb.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY m.season_id, bbb.striker
),
bowlers_wickets AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, bbb.bowler AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_wickets,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, bbb.bowler ASC) AS rn
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bbb.match_id = wt.match_id 
      AND bbb.over_id = wt.over_id 
      AND bbb.ball_id = wt.ball_id 
      AND bbb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON bbb.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY m.season_id, bbb.bowler
)
SELECT br.season_id, 
       br.player_id AS batsman_id, p1.player_name AS batsman_name, br.total_runs AS batsman_runs,
       bw.player_id AS bowler_id, p2.player_name AS bowler_name, bw.total_wickets AS bowler_wickets
FROM batsmen_runs br
JOIN bowlers_wickets bw ON br.season_id = bw.season_id AND br.rn = bw.rn
JOIN player p1 ON br.player_id = p1.player_id
JOIN player p2 ON bw.player_id = p2.player_id
WHERE br.rn <= 3
ORDER BY br.season_id ASC, br.rn ASC;

WITH partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        LEAST(b.striker, b.non_striker) as player_a,
        GREATEST(b.striker, b.non_striker) as player_b,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as partnership_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, LEAST(b.striker, b.non_striker), GREATEST(b.striker, b.non_striker)
),
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM partnerships
    GROUP BY match_id
),
individual_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, 
        b.striker as player_id, 
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as individual_score
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
),
paired AS (
    SELECT 
        p.match_id,
        p.player_a,
        p.player_b,
        p.partnership_runs,
        COALESCE(is1.individual_score, 0) as score_a,
        COALESCE(is2.individual_score, 0) as score_b
    FROM partnerships p
    JOIN max_partnerships mp ON p.match_id = mp.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = mp.max_runs
    LEFT JOIN individual_scores is1 ON p.match_id = is1.match_id AND p.player_a = is1.player_id
    LEFT JOIN individual_scores is2 ON p.match_id = is2.match_id AND p.player_b = is2.player_id
)
SELECT 
    match_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN score_a > score_b THEN player_a
        WHEN score_a < score_b THEN player_b
        WHEN player_a > player_b THEN player_a
        ELSE player_b
    END as player1_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN score_a > score_b THEN player_b
        WHEN score_a < score_b THEN player_a
        WHEN player_a > player_b THEN player_b
        ELSE player_a
    END as player2_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN score_a > score_b THEN score_a
        WHEN score_a < score_b THEN score_b
        ELSE GREATEST(score_a, score_b)
    END as player1_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN score_a > score_b THEN score_b
        WHEN score_a < score_b THEN score_a
        ELSE LEAST(score_a, score_b)
    END as player2_score,
    partnership_runs as partnership_score
FROM paired
ORDER BY match_id, player1_id, player2_id

SELECT name, movie_count
FROM (
  SELECT n.name, COUNT(*) as movie_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, n.name ASC) as rn
  FROM director_mapping dm
  JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
  JOIN genre g ON dm.movie_id = g.movie_id
  JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
  WHERE r.avg_rating > 8
    AND g.genre IN ('Drama', 'Action', 'Comedy')
  GROUP BY n.name
)
WHERE rn <= 4
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, name ASC

WITH track_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
  FROM Track
),
track_with_category AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds,
    t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 as duration_minutes,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.min_ms + ts.avg_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.avg_ms + ts.max_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t
  CROSS JOIN track_stats ts
)
SELECT 
  twc.category,
  MIN(twc.duration_minutes) as min_duration_minutes,
  MAX(twc.duration_minutes) as max_duration_minutes,
  COALESCE(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 0) as total_revenue
FROM track_with_category twc
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON twc.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY twc.category
ORDER BY twc.category

WITH cleaned AS (

        CompanyName,
        Location,
        TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Salary, '₹', ''), ',', ''), '/(yr|mo)$', '') AS DOUBLE) * CASE WHEN Salary LIKE '%/mo' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END AS annual_salary
    FROM SalaryDataset
    WHERE CompanyName IS NOT NULL
),
city_company_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        AVG(annual_salary) AS avg_salary
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE Location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
    GROUP BY Location, CompanyName
),
national_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(annual_salary) AS national_avg_salary
    FROM cleaned
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        cca.Location,
        cca.CompanyName,
        cca.avg_salary AS avg_salary_in_city,
        na.national_avg_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cca.Location ORDER BY cca.avg_salary DESC) AS rn
    FROM city_company_avg cca
    CROSS JOIN national_avg na
)
SELECT 
    Location,
    CompanyName AS "Company Name",
    avg_salary_in_city AS "Average Salary in State",
    national_avg_salary AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5

-- Final query - all bowlers with wickets, economy rate, strike rate, and best bowling
WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb 
        ON w.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND w.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND w.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND w.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs_conceded,
        COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_wickets_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        bb.match_id,
        COUNT(*) as wickets_in_match
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb 
        ON w.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND w.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND w.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND w.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
bowler_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        bb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
best_per_bowler AS (
    SELECT 
        w.bowler,
        w.wickets_in_match,
        COALESCE(r.runs_in_match, 0) as runs_in_match,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.bowler ORDER BY w.wickets_in_match DESC, COALESCE(r.runs_in_match, 0) ASC) as rn
    FROM bowler_wickets_per_match w
    LEFT JOIN bowler_runs_per_match r ON w.bowler = r.bowler AND w.match_id = r.match_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    bw.total_wickets,
    br.total_runs_conceded,
    br.balls_bowled,
    (1.0 * br.total_runs_conceded / br.balls_bowled) * 6 as economy_rate,
    1.0 * br.balls_bowled / bw.total_wickets as strike_rate,
    bpb.wickets_in_match || '-' || bpb.runs_in_match as best_bowling
FROM player p
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON p.player_id = bw.bowler
JOIN bowler_runs br ON p.player_id = br.bowler
JOIN best_per_bowler bpb ON bw.bowler = bpb.bowler AND bpb.rn = 1
ORDER BY bw.total_wickets DESC
